reviews.text: It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review. We sincerely appreciate Juliana's rating. We hope to continue earning her trust to meet all her pets' needs.
Very professional and friendly. The shop is small but usually has a little bit of everything.

It's a real pleasure to receive reviews like yours, Alex. We sincerely appreciate the time you took to give us the highest rating. We're confident we'll continue to be your trusted choice for all your pet care needs.
Very friendly staff

After saying something outrageous, which angered them and required me to apologize, they treated me exceptionally well, with respect and great professionalism. A highly recommended shop and, above all, staff.

It's a real pleasure to receive your feedback, Laura. It's wonderful to know that your visit was worthy of such a positive review. We hope to see you again soon at Kiwoko, where we're always ready to offer you the best possible experience.

Terrible. I went to them for advice on some fish and they told me they could live together in a community aquarium without any problem. That's not true at all; they are schooling and territorial fish. I absolutely do not recommend buying fish from them. They clearly have little knowledge or experience. I called them for a solution and they told me they couldn't do anything, implying that their only goal is to sell. I'm very dissatisfied. I'm only giving them fewer stars if I can't.
Excellent service from the guys and their products are great.

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review. David, knowing that your experience was excellent motivates us to continue offering the best every day. We sincerely thank you for taking a moment to share your satisfaction and trust in us.
Thank you Laura for your excellent service and dedication, and Diego was very kind. Highly recommended!
It's a real pleasure to receive your five stars, N0cks. We truly appreciate you taking the time to rate us. We hope to continue offering you and your pet the very best.
Excellent service
Laura and Claudia are amazing. They helped me choose everything I needed for my puppy. Wonderful service!

They're very friendly; I buy from them almost every week. I especially appreciated how friendly they were this time, and the little touch of including the free cookies with the QR code is a brilliant marketing idea. Well done! ;)
Great! The staff are lovely and always helpful. My dogs love going there because of how well they're treated.
All the girls were very nice
The people are very nice, they treat you very well and always give lots of love to your pet.
She usually goes there to shop and they give you great advice if you have any questions; they have tons of things for all kinds of pets and are always willing to help.
It's the shop I usually go to because it's close by. The girls who work there are lovely and treat my dog ​​wonderfully. Highly recommended!
Excellent service and products for all kinds of needs, Kiwoko is the best!

A really great pet store. I didn't know there was a Kiwoko in the neighborhood, I'm glad to find one.

You can find almost everything for dogs (and other animals) in the store. My favorite products are the Edgar Cooper cans (which my dog ​​Ada devours in no time), and their hygiene products, like their colognes and wipes.
The best service. Parys helped us and explained everything we needed to know.

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review. We truly appreciate you taking the time to give us five stars, Lucia. We hope to see you soon at Kiwoko so we can continue providing the best service for you and your furry companions.
It's a pleasure to receive your feedback, Susana. Knowing that you enjoyed your experience with us means a lot. We hope to continue being your trusted store for all your needs.
Parts, the saleswoman was very attentive and friendly

Alejandro, receiving your 5-star rating is a true honor for us. It's a real pleasure to know that your experience at Kiwoko was positive. We hope you continue to trust our team and everything we offer for the well-being of your animals.
Very tidy shop, the staff are very friendly, they help you with everything you need and they always give treats; my dog ​​loves coming here
She loved the yogurt.

The saleswoman who helped me yesterday was very kind and gave me some treats for my dog.
I loved their customer service.

The staff were very friendly. They were a great help in finding what we needed and they also treated our dog very well, even giving her several treats, after asking our permission first, of course. We'll definitely be back because we left delighted.

Good morning! I just bought a product for my dog ​​and the staff were very kind. They gave my dog ​​treats and treated him very well.
10/10 service
Nice and smiling workers. I can find many varieties of food for my ill cat., that are appropriate for him.
Patri and Paris's service was 100/10, super friendly and attentive. Thank you so much!
Very happy with the service received from the store staff
Excellent professionals and they guide you phenomenally.
The staff at the store were super nice ☺️ They helped us as much as possible, even though they didn't have the harness we needed!

I work in customer service, and some people with negative reviews need a month in this job. I'm absolutely certain they're in the wrong store. I've ALWAYS gone to this store at Plenilunio and I've never received bad service. I've met so many people hanging around the store and at the checkout. THANK YOU for your attention. And of course, everyone has a bad day now and then; we're all human. But personally, in the eight years I've been going there, I've never received bad service. Thank you for everything, and keep up the good work!
We love going to the store, they are very attentive, they always treat us super well and we love their free sweets… which we eat as soon as we get home.
We love this store. The staff are always super friendly, they help you find any product you need, and they give great advice.

We're frequent customers, and even more so since our puppy arrived. We want to highlight the excellent service from the entire team: they're always so kind, friendly, and loving with our Kiwi ❤️.

Besides the wide variety of pet products, we really appreciate Kiwoko's philosophy and all the services they offer, as they demonstrate their commitment to the well-being of animals and their customers.

Without a doubt, a top-notch store in Plenilunio. Thank you for making every visit such a pleasant experience! You're all fantastic.

They don't let you buy fish unless it's on the days they specify, and the other one scolds me for touching things I'm not going to buy. The service is terrible. I'm forced to go to another store, and they treated me much better. If they hire people who don't provide good service, they shouldn't hire them at all!

I've learned that I will never go back to this store / KIWOKO PLENILUNIO

We truly appreciate the time you took to share your excellent review, Mercury. This kind of recognition motivates us to continue providing the best possible experience for our customers and their pets. We hope to continue earning your trust in the future.

On June 13, 2026, we went to this store and were served by a girl who deserves 5 stars. She was super friendly and empathetic, and she recommended a food for our adopted Ragdoll kitten. She was absolutely right, and we'll go back whenever we can. We don't remember your name, but we thought you were fantastic. (She loves the salmon gel.)
The girl from Paris was very nice and lovely.

The girl with glasses—I didn't ask her name—is very attentive, friendly, and professional. I highly recommend the store.

Thank you so much for your help! 🙏🏽👏🏽
The girl was very friendly. The stock is limited by the store space...which isn't much. That's all.

I want to give a very special thanks to Kiwoco Plenilunio and to Rubén and Natalia, who are two incredible people. They always provide impeccable service, constantly smiling, answering all your questions, and helping you choose the best option based on your specific needs. They are so kind to our dogs, and Merlín and Santiño run through the shopping center, so excited to see them and for the treats we buy. Rubén and Natalia patiently and lovingly give them the treats. They finish the experience with affectionate cuddles that my dogs absolutely love. And we, the customers, love returning to stores with such wonderful people. Thank you!
The staff were super attentive and I found everything I needed!!
They only have fish as animals…

It's all a bit chaotic.

But they're nice.
Excellent service and everything was great.
Friendly and quick service

The service from the shop assistant with the little beard and black hair (I think he told me his name was Rubén) was wonderful. He was very helpful and gave us great advice, and he also pointed out some special offers so we could buy more things at a good price. 10/10
Their products are always excellent ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ and the service from the girls at the Pleniluniim store is the best 🫶🏼✨🐶 We love it and always come back 💯 …

My go-to pet shop, they always give me perfect advice on my needs and those of my pets. Specifically, the last time I went, Natalia and Laura helped me—they were incredibly kind and professional. Thank you so much, ladies! See you soon!

Excellent pet store. They have a wide variety of products for dogs, cats, and other pets, from food and toys to high-quality accessories. The staff is very friendly, especially Claudia, who helped us today. They are always willing to help and recommend the best for each pet. The store is also clean and well-organized. I will definitely return and highly recommend it to anyone who loves their animals.
It has been a pleasure talking to Laura and Natalia, they are very nice and do their job very well.
Parys is a very good employee. Excellent service; ask for her so she can help you. Thank you for your attention.
Excellent service and great charisma from the girl Paris, very kind and respectful!
Excellent service, the girls are super nice and there are plenty of offers
A wonderful store and especially the employees!! 🦋🦋 …
The girl was really nice, she treated us super well
Every time we've been there, a lovely girl has served us and helped us a lot. It's a small place, but highly recommended.
A very good store with very friendly employees
Good service.
Great atmosphere and the staff are super friendly
Excellent service 😊 …
I've been shopping at this Kiwoko for many years and the service is excellent. The staff are very friendly, especially Parys who was very kind and helpful.

The service from the young woman left much to be desired. Aside from the fact that what we were asking for wasn't possible, she had a condescending attitude towards my mother, as if she owned the place, speaking with superiority and rudeness. I went to exchange an unused float with the receipt, which meant I couldn't get a refund, even though she had served us less than two weeks prior. The young man wasn't any better, but he was much more polite, not laughing like the other person who was speaking to my mother.
Excellent service and a great atmosphere
I went to get a fish with my son, the service was excellent as well as the advice for my son and me, thank you very much!

We bought a couple of products for our dog and the tattoo shop assistant gave us excellent service, finding the ideal size which fits him perfectly. It's a pleasure when you are treated so professionally, we will definitely return to this store (Plenilunio).
Excellent service from Laura and a great variety

Finally, I found someone who was interested in my case! Aquarium keeping isn't for everyone! And not everyone has to understand it. But selling just for the sake of selling is NOT OKAY. I want to thank Ruben for taking all the time he needed to understand my situation and help me with the problem I was having with my aquarium! Excellent experience at this Kiwoko!
Very friendly staff and a good atmosphere
Excellent service, they answered all my questions! Both the guy and the girl who worked the afternoon shift were great.
The service is fantastic! I always buy things for our two furry friends here, and they're always so attentive! Thank you so much!
The shop assistants were lovely... especially Leslie... she gave me great advice.
Always great!
A very good experience in the store. Ruben helped me and answered all my questions. A true professional.
The service is very good, the girls who helped me were amazing. I'm from Bolivia and I can say that my experience in the store was on another level.
Parys provided excellent service.
Excellent service and hospitality at this Kiwoko, especially from Rubén, very good attention
I received excellent service; the staff were very pleasant and friendly and answered my questions very well.
A fantastic team! Both Rubén and the rest of the staff treat you wonderfully, always willing to help! Molly's favorite shop 🐶 …

My wife went to pick up some Aquatlantis brand turtle filters this afternoon. To my surprise, when she brought them home and I opened the box, it was completely empty!
This isn't the first time there's been a problem with the filters because one is missing. Is it so difficult for the cashier to check that the box contains what it's supposed to? I'll go back tomorrow with the receipt; I hope they don't complain when I return it. My wife doesn't know anything about turtles and went because I couldn't, but the least the store clerk could do is check.

It's a real pleasure to receive such positive feedback as yours, Luis. It encourages us to continue offering the best for our valued customers and their pets. Thank you for taking a moment to share your experience and rate it so highly.
Please update your Google schedules... you're wasting everyone's time...
We greatly appreciate your feedback, Rafael. It's always a pleasure to know that our customers are satisfied with our services. We look forward to continuing to meet your expectations in the future.

As always, great attention, clear answers to my questions, and excellent service. Laura helped me and was super attentive, friendly, and pleasant. It was a pleasure to have her help; everything was perfect.

We're so glad to see such a positive review from you, Hugo. We'd love to continue offering you the best possible experience every time you visit. We hope you and your pets always enjoy yourselves. See you soon!
A trusted site to buy things for our four-legged children
We found what we were looking for and the service was excellent! The only downside was that we didn't bring our furry friends ☹️ Next time we'll definitely bring them along 🐶🐶 …

Great! I'd been shopping there before and was always very satisfied, but this last time I went with my dog ​​and he was treated wonderfully. He already has a favorite store. We definitely have a favorite Kiwoko now.
Small place but they had what I needed, and the staff were very friendly. Thank you.
Great attention from all the boys.
The staff were so attentive!! ✨ I'll always come back because the service is top-notch.
Excellent service and treatment! Highly recommended!
A very nice shop and the young man who served us, Rubén, was wonderful; there should be many more like him. His colleague was also very attentive and very nice.
The employees were super nice.
Sara has treated us wonderfully. It couldn't be better.
Sara's service was fantastic!!

Your feedback means a lot to all of us, Helena. It motivates us to keep going, knowing that our efforts are appreciated. We hope to continue offering you the best service and that you continue to enjoy every visit to our store. Thank you for being part of the Kiwoko family!
My dog ​​is so happy with her treats!!! There's no greater pleasure for her haha ​​Thanks to the girls who work there, they are super friendly.
The girls were super friendly and caring, they gave us some sweets and the service was fantastic, we'll be back at Plenilunio ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

Good morning, I wanted to share my experience at the Kiwoko store in Plenilunio. It was excellent—the service was outstanding, and the products and quality were top-notch. The employees were especially knowledgeable about each product; they explained how each one worked and its benefits to me. I left very satisfied with the great service I received. I highly recommend it!
Natalia and Ruben's service is impeccable; they are attentive, professional, and passionate about animals and their work. Thank you so much for the great service!
They have everything and are very friendly. They even have a veterinary clinic in the store.
I went the other day for the first time and I had a really good experience. I quickly found what I was looking for and the service was excellent. I recommend the store.

I really liked this shop. I went to buy some treats for my pet and the service was impeccable. I didn't know which ones to choose and they recommended some that he loved! They were very kind, especially the girl with pink hair (I didn't catch her name, haha), it's so nice to have such friendly service. Plus, the shop was super well organized. I'll definitely go back when I need anything else.

The staff's service was appalling and intolerable. They didn't have the cat litter that was on promotion. They said they'd give me a voucher, but they didn't have any vouchers. They had no sense of how to offer solutions. They told me to go to another store when their obligation is to replace what they don't have with something similar. Instead of apologizing, the employee with pink hair called me rude. The other employee said I should have come earlier, that they did have it.

The one who called me rude (everyone reveals their true colors) is named Carla, and she wasted my time. She's very slow and doesn't treat customers well. She tells those she considers she's served well, because she spent half an hour ringing them up, to leave her a good review. I don't want their cat litter or anything else from that store.
Everything was great! Sara's service was perfect and very professional 😁 …
Attentive and friendly staff, highly recommended. Great variety of products.
I went this morning to buy food for my dog ​​and they were very friendly. Sara, the girl who helped me, was very professional. The prices were good.
Excellent service.
It's not clear in the photo, but this Betta and other fish have a lot of white spot disease; they shouldn't be exposed.

It's a real pleasure to hear you had such a positive experience in our animal world. Your feedback encourages us to continue offering the best for you and your pets. Thank you for taking a moment to share your opinion, Carmen.

The staff at Kiwoko Plenilunio are always so kind to my dog. She loves visiting them because she gets lots of pampering, and besides the food I buy, I always find a little ball to take home, which she really enjoys. Thank you so much.

A very disappointing experience at Kiwoko Plenilunio Madrid. I was served by an employee named Rubén, and frankly, it was one of the worst experiences I've ever had. His attitude was quite unpleasant, showing a complete lack of interest in helping and responding in a curt and unprofessional manner. A very bad experience.
I went to buy some fish for my children's aquarium and they treated me very well 👍 …

I always have trouble finding things for my guinea pig, and since I discovered this place, I haven't looked back. They make my life so much easier. I never expect "extraordinary" customer service when I go into a store, but here the service from the girls is amazing. The redhead is a sweetheart and focused on what I needed from the moment I walked in until I left. This store motivates me to buy my guinea pig things I didn't even need; now he lives in a mansion! Haha

I went a few days ago to buy food for my cat and it was a very pleasant experience. There was a girl with reddish-brown hair who was super friendly and even struck up a conversation with me. The products were also of very good quality.
The aquarium and fish section gave me a bad impression. I didn't feel well advised.

The staff were unpleasant and, in my opinion, lacked the necessary technical knowledge for a store of this type. They didn't offer adequate advice. The product selection was limited, and I'd say the prices were very high compared to other online options.
The best animal store
Very professional people, always attentive to your needs, they guide you regarding food and everything necessary for your pets (family).
Excellent service from Parys and Natalia, I will return
It's a fantastic store! The staff are so friendly and helpful. The service is excellent and their products are amazing! I'm absolutely delighted! 🤩 …
Super friendly staff and they have everything!!! We'll definitely be back with our fur baby!!!🐶🐶♥️♥️ …

The girls were so nice, cheerful, and helpful!
I love the store; I've been a member for a while now and I couldn't want to leave anything out!
Thank you so much, KIWOKO team!
